data.title: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
data.description: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.
